changes_made.explanation: Consolidated evaluation criteria to 'accuracy' since 'perceived accuracy' refers to the same underlying concept. The guideline description accurately captures the human evaluation procedure described in the paper.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on data-efficient fine-tuning for text-editing tasks using unsupervised core-set selection. Main contributions involve showing comparable performance to CoEDIT with 70% less training data. Human evaluation was conducted with 3 evaluators comparing DEFT-UCS vs CoEDIT outputs. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was performed. The paper thoroughly evaluates across 8 datasets and 6 text-editing tasks.
